name: adapt_cart_limit_php_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: max_items.txt (a spec file the cart limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old limit into Cart.php
prompts: Create src/Cart.php declaring App\Cart with a public static function canAdd(int $count): bool returning true if $count is less than or equal to the integer in max_items.txt (currently 5), else false. Read the limit from the file (file_get_contents) at call time - do not hardcode it.
max_items.txt has changed. Make sure canAdd() enforces the CURRENT limit in the file.

disruptions.description: max_items.txt tightened to a lower limit

test_setup_files.tests/CartTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Cart.php';

final class CartTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testEnforcesCurrentLimit(): void
    {
        $limit = (int) trim(file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/../max_items.txt'));
        $this->assertTrue(\App\Cart::canAdd($limit));
        $this->assertFalse(\App\Cart::canAdd($limit + 1));
    }
}

reference_solution.src/Cart.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Cart
{
    public static function canAdd(int $count): bool
    {
        $limit = (int) trim(file_get_contents(__DIR__ . '/../max_items.txt'));
        return $count <= $limit;
    }
}

files.src/Cart.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Cart
{
    public static function canAdd(int $count): bool
    {
        return $count <= 5;
    }
}
